user_facing_summary:
Shading plan for `dark_mage`
Brief: Hard one-step shadows for dark fantasy mage robes: light from top-front/+X-up; undersides, under chin/hood, armpits, sash fold, far limbs slightly darker, under feet.

Light: top-front / +X-up
Rules: one_step_darker, no_gradients

Overall:
Hard 1–2px shade bands only. Violet/charcoal robe locals step toward near-black; pale face steps to shadow_beige; crimson sash to muted plum. Far limbs slightly darker. Eyes stay on base.

Per design layer (paint shadows on design/layers/ only):
  - upper_arm_far (2 stroke intent(s)): Far sleeve underside + armpit fold; slightly darker than near.
      · [underside] underside_bottom_edge → near_black (#0E151C)
      · [armpit] armpit_fold → near_black (#0E151C)
  - lower_arm_far (1 stroke intent(s)): Far cuff underside and glove underside darker.
      · [cuff] underside_bottom_edge → near_black (#0E151C)
  - upper_leg_far (1 stroke intent(s)): Far robe skirt hem + far-limb darken.
      · [hem] underside_bottom_edge → near_black (#0E151C)
  - lower_leg_far (1 stroke intent(s)): Boot sole and lower shin underside.
      · [sole] under_feet → near_black (#0E151C)
  - torso (3 stroke intent(s)): Hem underside band; under sash fold; armpit-side charcoal panels slightly darker.
      · [hem] underside_bottom_edge → near_black (#0E151C)
      · [under_sash] under_chest_waist_fold → muted_plum (#291A1F)
      · [cloak_sides] underside → near_black (#0E151C)
  - head (2 stroke intent(s)): Under-chin and lower hood edge darker charcoal; brow band already present; face cheek underside #A08884. Do not cover eyes.
      · [under_chin] under_chin → near_black (#0E151C)
      · [hood_lower] underside → near_black (#0E151C)
  - upper_arm_near (2 stroke intent(s)): Near sleeve underside + armpit fold.
      · [underside] underside_bottom_edge → near_black (#0E151C)
      · [armpit] armpit_fold → near_black (#0E151C)
  - lower_arm_near (1 stroke intent(s)): Near cuff underside and glove underside.
      · [cuff] underside_bottom_edge → near_black (#0E151C)
  - upper_leg_near (1 stroke intent(s)): Near robe skirt hem underside.
      · [hem] underside_bottom_edge → near_black (#0E151C)
  - lower_leg_near (1 stroke intent(s)): Boot sole and lower shin underside.
      · [sole] under_feet → near_black (#0E151C)

Shade palette (one darker step from local flat color):
  - off_white (#DEC1B5) → shadow_beige (#A08884)
  - shadow_beige (#A08884) → muted_plum (#291A1F)
  - deep_red (#790F19) → muted_plum (#291A1F)
  - muted_plum (#291A1F) → muted_plum_alt (#3D2334)
  - muted_plum_alt (#3D2334) → near_black (#0E151C)
  - near_black_alt (#17171D) → near_black (#0E151C)
  - near_black (#0E151C) → near_black (#0E151C)

Apply with MCP paint tools only (fill_rect / draw_line / paint_pixels / paint_from_commands) on design layers — hard 1px–2px bands, no gradients, no Shell/PIL. Do not rewrite base geometry. Eyes live on the naked base head layer — shade design/head clothing only; do not clear or flood the head in a way that strips base eyes from compose underlays. Then compose_character (or re-compose). If this matches, say OK; otherwise revise the plan.
